name: commit-harbor
description: A Git workbench derived from Git Jet, with persistent commit message pane height.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Commit Harbor does not run Git in Restricted Mode: a repository can make Git execute programs (hooks, fsmonitor, sshCommand, credential helpers). Trust the workspace to enable it.

commands.title: Include All Hunks of File into Commit
Exclude All Hunks of File from Commit
Navigate Log to Selected Branch Head
Compare HEAD, Staged and Local Versions
Load Branch Protection Rules from GitHub
Split Chunk and Include Selected Lines into Commit
Select Language Model for AI Actions…

commitharbor.git.path.markdownDescription: **Path to Git executable.** Empty: auto-detected (the path of the built-in Git extension, `git.path`, or `git` on the PATH). Set it in the Workspace settings for "Set this path only for the current project". **Test** in the [Git Settings](command:commitharbor.settings.git) page runs `git --version`; a new path applies without reloading the window.

commitharbor.commit.enableStagingArea.markdownDescription:
**Enable staging area.** This will disable changelists support. Only for non-modal commit interface.

The Commit tool window shows Staged / Unstaged / Unversioned like git itself.

commitharbor.commit.warnCrlf.markdownDescription: Warn if CRLF line separators are about to be committed (while `core.autocrlf` is not set): the "Line Separators Warning" dialog with Fix and Commit / Commit As Is.

commitharbor.commit.warnDetached.markdownDescription: Warn when committing in detached HEAD or during rebase (a problem above the commit buttons with Commit Anyway).

commitharbor.commit.warnLargeFiles.markdownDescription: Warn when committing files larger than `#commitharbor.commit.warnLargeFilesLimitMb#` MB. Repositories that use Git LFS are not checked.

commitharbor.commit.warnLargeFilesLimitM.markdownDescription: Size, in MB, over which `#commitharbor.commit.warnLargeFiles#` warns about a committed file.

commitharbor.commit.warnBadFileNames.markdownDescription: Warn when committing files with names that might cause issues on other systems (names reserved on Windows such as `CON` or `aux.txt`, or characters like `<>:"|?*`). Not checked on Windows.

commitharbor.cherryPick.addSuffix.markdownDescription: Add the 'cherry-picked from <hash>' suffix when picking commits pushed to protected branches (`git cherry-pick -x`).

commitharbor.push.autoUpdateOnReject.markdownDescription: Auto-update if push of the current branch was rejected: update with the remembered method (`#commitharbor.push.rejectedUpdateMethod#`) and push again, without the Push Rejected dialog.

commitharbor.push.showDialogOnCommitAndP.markdownDescription: Show Push dialog for Commit and Push.

commitharbor.push.showDialogOnlyForProte.markdownDescription: Show Push dialog only when committing to protected branches (with `#commitharbor.push.showDialogOnCommitAndPush#` on).

commitharbor.push.protectedBranches.markdownDescription: Protected branches: patterns (regular expressions) of branches that must not be force-pushed or have their pushed commits rewritten. The Git Settings page edits them as `master;main`.

commitharbor.push.loadGitHubProtection.markdownDescription: Load branch protection rules from GitHub. GitHub rules are added to the local rules and synced on every fetch (with the GitHub account already logged in).

enumDescriptions: Merge incoming changes into the current branch
Rebase the current branch on top of incoming changes
commit-harbor: follow `branch.<name>.rebase` / `pull.rebase` of the git config
commitharbor.update.method.markdownDescription: Update method: how Update Project brings the incoming commits into the current branch (Merge by default, like the IDE).

commitharbor.update.saveChangesPolicy.markdownDescription: Clean working tree using: how local changes are saved before an operation that needs a clean working tree (Update Project, Smart Checkout…) and restored after it.

commitharbor.update.filterPaths.markdownDescription: Filter "Update Project" information by paths: folders (absolute or relative to the first workspace folder) that filter the commits shown by View Commits after Update Project. Empty: All.

enumDescriptions: Check the remotes with `git ls-remote` (no fetch), except SSH remotes served by an external SSH agent
Check every remote
Do not check
commitharbor.fetch.checkIncoming.markdownDescription: Explicitly check for incoming commits on remotes: after each fetch and every `#commitharbor.fetch.intervalMinutes#` minutes, mark the branches with unfetched commits in the Branches popup and panel. Older `true` / `false` values are read as Always / Never.

enumDescriptions: Follow git config
--prune-tags
--tags
--no-tags
commitharbor.fetch.tags.markdownDescription: Fetch tags: which tags every fetch brings (Auto follows the git config).

commitharbor.branches.syncControl.description: Execute branch operations on all roots when the workspace has several repositories on the same branch (WebStorm: Settings › Git › Execute branch operations on all roots).

commitharbor.git.useCredentialHelper.description: Let git use the configured credential helper (system keychain). When off, git's helpers are disabled (`-c credential.helper=`) and Commit Harbor asks for credentials itself, answering from the passwords it remembered ("Remember" of the Log In dialog, see Passwords › Save passwords) (WebStorm: Settings › Git › Use credential helper).

commitharbor.stash.combineWithShelf.description: Show stashes and shelved changes in one tab of the Commit tool window, "Stashes and Shelves", in place of the Shelf tab (WebStorm: Combine stashes and shelves). Off, as in the IDE: a "Stash" tab after the Shelf only while there are stashes.

commitharbor.stash.compareWith.description: What Show Diff on a stash compares with: the local working tree or the stash's parent commit.

commitharbor.git.detectNestedRepositorie.description: Register by themselves the Git repositories found anywhere under the workspace folders (up to 5 levels deep, skipping hidden folders, node_modules, vendor and build output), as WebStorm does with the <Project> directory mapping. When off, Commit Harbor only reports them ("N Git repositories are not registered": Add Roots / Ignore).

commitharbor.git.ignoredRoots.description: Git repositories under the workspace folders that Commit Harbor never registers by itself: paths relative to a workspace folder (or absolute). "Ignore" of the "not registered" notification adds to it.

commitharbor.keymap.description: Keyboard shortcuts: VS Code native, or the JetBrains equivalents (Ctrl+K commit, Ctrl+Shift+K push, Ctrl+T update, Alt+9 log).

commitharbor.console.logCommands.description: Log every git command run to the "Commit Harbor" output channel (the Console tab of WebStorm).

commitharbor.commit.signOff.description: Add a Signed-off-by trailer to commits (git commit --signoff). Same as WebStorm's Sign-off commit option.

commitharbor.commit.runHooks.description: Run Git commit hooks (pre-commit, commit-msg). Uncheck to commit with --no-verify. WebStorm: Advanced Settings › Do not run Git commit hooks.

commitharbor.commit.clearInitialMessage.description: Do not prefill the commit message with the template or the previous message (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control › Commit › Clear initial commit message).

commitharbor.commit.closeAfterCommit.description: Hide the Commit tool window after a successful commit.

commitharbor.commit.inspections.subjectM.description: Warn when the commit subject is longer than this many characters (0 disables).

commitharbor.commit.inspections.bodyMaxL.description: Warn when a body line is longer than this many characters (0 disables).

commitharbor.commit.inspections.requireB.description: Warn when there is no blank line between the subject and the body.

commitharbor.commit.inspections.spelling.description: Underline misspelled words of the commit message with quick fixes (right click or Alt+Enter: suggestions, Save to dictionary), using a bundled English dictionary (WebStorm: commit message inspections › Spelling / Proofreading › Typo).

commitharbor.commit.spelling.words.description: Words accepted by the commit message spell checker ("Save to dictionary" adds here when Code Spell Checker is not installed).

commitharbor.commit.spelling.shareWithCS.markdownDescription: Coexist with **Code Spell Checker** (cSpell): accept its `cSpell.words`, `cSpell.userWords` and `cSpell.ignoreWords`, and save "Save to dictionary" into `cSpell.userWords` when it is installed. cSpell cannot check webviews, so the commit message is still checked by Commit Harbor.

commitharbor.commit.checks.reformatCode.description: Commit check: format the files to be committed with the document formatter before committing (WebStorm: Reformat code).

commitharbor.commit.checks.optimizeImpor.description: Commit check: run the 'Organize Imports' code action on the files to be committed.

commitharbor.commit.checks.cleanup.description: Commit check: apply the cleanup code actions (`commitharbor.commit.checks.cleanupActions`, 'Fix All' by default) to the files to be committed and save them (WebStorm: Cleanup).

commitharbor.commit.checks.cleanupAction.markdownDescription: Code action kinds applied by the **Cleanup** commit check, in order: VS Code's counterpart of WebStorm's cleanup inspection profile ("Cleanup with '<profile>' profile"). E.g. `source.fixAll.eslint`, `source.organizeImports`, `source.addMissingImports.ts`.

commitharbor.commit.checks.analyzeCode.description: Commit check: report the errors and warnings of the files to be committed, with Review code analysis (WebStorm: Analyze code).

enumDescriptions: Errors and warnings, as WebStorm's code analysis.
Only errors.
commitharbor.commit.checks.analyzeSeveri.description: Diagnostics that the Analyze code commit check reports (the inspection profile's severities in WebStorm).

commitharbor.commit.checks.checkTodo.description: Commit check: warn when the added lines contain TODO items (WebStorm: Check TODO).

commitharbor.commit.checks.todoPattern.description: Regular expression used by the Check TODO commit check.

commitharbor.commit.checks.runTask.description: Commit check: label of a tasks.json task to run before committing; a non-zero exit code asks for confirmation (WebStorm: Run tool / Run configuration).

commitharbor.commit.checks.runAdvancedCh.description: Run the advanced commit checks (Analyze code, Check TODO, Run task) after the commit is created and report problems in a notification instead of blocking the commit (WebStorm: Run advanced checks after a commit is done).

commitharbor.commit.groupBy.description: Group By of the Commit tool window (WebStorm: View Options › Group By): any combination of directory, module (nearest package.json) and repository (multi-root workspaces); empty for a flat list.

commitharbor.commit.commitAllWhenNothing.description: Staging area: commit every tracked change when nothing is staged; the Commit button reads "Commit All" (WebStorm: Commit All when Nothing Is Staged).

commitharbor.commit.doubleClickOpens.description: What double-click / Enter opens for a changed file in the Commit tool window (WebStorm: View Options › Show on Double-Click).

commitharbor.commit.diffInSeparateWindow.description: Open diffs from the Commit tool window in a new editor group (WebStorm: Show Diff in Separate Window).

commitharbor.commit.showCommitControls.description: Show the commit message editor and buttons in the Commit tool window (WebStorm: Advanced Settings › Toggle commit controls).

commitharbor.changelists.highlightInacti.description: Highlight (dim) files from inactive changelists (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control › Changelists).

commitharbor.changelists.highlightConfli.description: Highlight files with changelist conflicts: files modified while they belonged to an inactive changelist (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control › Changelists).

commitharbor.changelists.onEditInactive.description: What to do when a file from an inactive changelist is edited: ask, shelve the changes, move the file to the active changelist, switch the active changelist, or do nothing (WebStorm: Show dialog on attempt to edit file from inactive changelist).

commitharbor.changelists.emptyInactivePo.description: When an empty changelist becomes inactive: keep it or remove it silently (WebStorm: Settings › Changelists).

commitharbor.fetch.auto.description: Fetch automatically every N minutes (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control › Git › Fetch automatically).

commitharbor.fetch.intervalMinutes.description: Interval, in minutes, of the automatic fetch.

commitharbor.fetch.prune.description: Remove remote-tracking references that no longer exist on the remote when fetching (`--prune`).

commitharbor.update.showOptions.description: Show the update options before Update Project (WebStorm: Confirmation › Show options before Update).

commitharbor.update.filterByPaths.markdownDescription: Filter the Update Project information by the workspace folders.
commitharbor.update.filterByPaths.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#commitharbor.update.filterPaths#`; `true` is still read as the workspace folders.

commitharbor.update.updateSubmodules.description: After Update Project, submodules in detached HEAD check out the commit their parent records (`git submodule update --recursive -- <path>`), with their local changes saved and restored, as WebStorm does. Submodules on a branch are updated from their own tracked branch.

commitharbor.push.rejectedUpdateMethod.description: Update method remembered from the Push Rejected dialog.

commitharbor.push.warnForce.description: Ask for confirmation before a force push (WebStorm Advanced Settings: Disable force-push warning).

enumDescriptions: In native Keychain: VS Code's secret storage (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, libsecret).
Do not save, forget passwords after restart. Switching to it removes the passwords Commit Harbor saved in the keychain.
commitharbor.passwords.storage.markdownDescription: Where the passwords remembered by the **Log In** dialog are saved (WebStorm: Settings › Appearance & Behavior › System Settings › Passwords › Save passwords). KeePass has no counterpart in VS Code.

commitharbor.shelf.location.description: Directory where shelved changes are stored (empty: the extension's global storage). WebStorm: Change Shelves Location.

commitharbor.shelf.baseRevisions.description: Shelve base revisions of files under DVCS (allows three-way unshelve).

commitharbor.shelf.removeOnUnshelve.description: Remove successfully applied files from the shelf after unshelving (WebStorm: Settings › Shelf).

commitharbor.merge.autoApplyNonConflicti.description: Automatically apply non-conflicting changes when resolving conflicts (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control › Confirmation).

commitharbor.merge.iterativeDialog.description: Resolve conflicts with the iterative Conflicts dialog of recent IntelliJ versions (Unresolved / Resolved groups, Resolve All Simple Conflicts, Accept and Finish) instead of the classic one (Accept Yours / Accept Theirs / Merge…).

commitharbor.confirmation.addOnCreate.description: When files are created in the editor: ask whether to add them to Git, add silently, or do nothing (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control › Confirmation).

commitharbor.confirmation.removeOnDelete.description: When tracked files are deleted in the editor: ask whether to remove them from Git, remove silently, or do nothing.

commitharbor.patch.confirmation.description: Show a confirmation when a patch is created (WebStorm: Confirmation › When patch is created).

commitharbor.patch.detectOnTheFly.description: When the window gets the focus and the clipboard holds a patch copied in another application, open Apply Patch with it (WebStorm: "Analyze and apply patch from clipboard on the fly", the checkbox of the Apply Patch from Clipboard dialog).

commitharbor.branches.restoreWorkspace.description: Restore the open editors when switching back to a branch (WebStorm: Confirmation › Restore workspace when switching branches).

commitharbor.issueNavigation.links.description: Issue navigation rules: regular expression for issue ids and the link they open, with $0, $1… groups (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control › Issue Navigation).

commitharbor.github.cloneUsingSsh.description: Use SSH URLs when cloning from a GitHub account (WebStorm: Settings › GitHub › Clone using ssh).

commitharbor.github.connectionTimeout.description: Connection timeout, in milliseconds, for GitHub API requests (WebStorm: Settings › GitHub › Connection timeout, shown in seconds by the "GitHub Accounts and Settings…" dialog).

commitharbor.github.defaultAccount.markdownDescription: Login of the GitHub account used by Share, Gist, Clone, Sync Fork and the CI checks column (WebStorm: Settings › GitHub › Set as Default, kept per project). Empty: the only account, or the one VS Code granted. Managed with **Commit Harbor: GitHub Accounts and Settings…**, which also adds accounts with a token.

commitharbor.annotate.format.description: Fields shown by Annotate (WebStorm: Annotate › View).

commitharbor.annotate.dateFormat.description: Date format of the annotations (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control › Date format).

commitharbor.annotate.showTimestamp.description: Show the commit time next to the date in annotations (WebStorm: Annotate › Show Commit Timestamp).

commitharbor.annotate.ignoreWhitespace.description: Annotate with `-w` (WebStorm: Annotate › Options › Ignore Whitespaces).

commitharbor.annotate.detectMovementsWit.description: Annotate with `-M` (WebStorm: Detect Movements Within File).

commitharbor.annotate.detectMovementsAcr.description: Annotate with `-C` (WebStorm: Detect Movements Across Files).

enumDescriptions: Initials
Last Name
First Name
Full Name
Email
commitharbor.annotate.names.description: How annotations show authors (WebStorm: Annotate › View › Names).

enumDescriptions: A color per author
Newer commits get a stronger tint
No colors
commitharbor.annotate.colors.description: Background colors of the annotations in the desktop editor (WebStorm: Annotate › View › Colors).

commitharbor.editor.highlightRecentDays.description: Highlight files changed in the last N days in the Explorer (0 disables; WebStorm: Settings › Version Control › Highlight files changed in the last N days).

commitharbor.editor.highlightDirectories.description: Highlight directories that contain modified files (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control).

commitharbor.editor.highlightInErrorStri.description: Highlight modified lines in the error stripe as well as in the gutter (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control). Writes `scm.diffDecorations` (`all` / `gutter`).

commitharbor.editor.showWhitespaceOnlyCh.description: Show whitespace-only changes in the gutter (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control). Writes `scm.diffDecorationsIgnoreTrimWhitespace`; VS Code cannot give them a color of their own.

commitharbor.push.updateAllRootsOnReject.description: When a push is rejected, update all repositories of the workspace before retrying, not only the rejected one (WebStorm: Push Rejected › Update all repositories).

commitharbor.changelists.createAutomatic.description: Create a changelist automatically for the changes of a cherry-pick, revert, unshelve or applied patch (WebStorm: Settings › Changelists).

commitharbor.changelists.allowPartial.description: Allow putting changes within one file into different changelists (WebStorm: Settings › Changelists).

commitharbor.annotate.codeVision.description: Show the latest author of each symbol above it (WebStorm: Code Vision › Code author).

commitharbor.hosting.servers.description: Hosting service of self-hosted servers by host name, e.g. {"git.example.com": "gitlab"} (WebStorm: Settings › Version Control › GitLab / GitHub servers).

commitharbor.commit.showDiffPreview.description: Show an embedded diff preview of the selected file in the Commit view (WebStorm: View Options › Show Diff Preview).

enumDescriptions: New UI Dark or Light after the VS Code color theme: Commit Harbor's default look.
The colors and fonts of the active VS Code color theme.
WebStorm's default dark theme (Islands).
WebStorm's default light theme (Islands).
Darcula colors with the Islands look.
The High Contrast theme of the Islands group.
The Dark theme of the New UI.
The Light theme of the New UI.
The Light theme of the New UI with a light header.
The classic Darcula theme.
The classic IntelliJ Light theme (Classic UI).
The classic High Contrast theme (Classic UI).
commitharbor.appearance.theme.markdownDescription: Theme of the Commit Harbor views, like WebStorm's **Settings › Appearance › Theme**. `auto` keeps the New UI Dark or Light palette after the kind of the VS Code color theme; `vscode` follows the colors of the VS Code theme. [Commit Harbor: Appearance…](command:commitharbor.appearance.open) previews the themes and customizes them.

commitharbor.appearance.syncWithOs.markdownDescription: Sync with OS: use `#commitharbor.appearance.preferredDarkTheme#` or `#commitharbor.appearance.preferredLightTheme#` after the kind (dark or light) of the VS Code color theme, instead of `#commitharbor.appearance.theme#`.

commitharbor.appearance.preferredDarkThe.markdownDescription: Theme of the Commit Harbor views on a dark VS Code theme while `#commitharbor.appearance.syncWithOs#` is on (Preferred Theme › For Dark OS).

commitharbor.appearance.preferredLightTh.markdownDescription: Theme of the Commit Harbor views on a light VS Code theme while `#commitharbor.appearance.syncWithOs#` is on (Preferred Theme › For Light OS).

commitharbor.appearance.colorOverrides.markdownDescription: Customize colors: palette token → color over the theme, e.g. `{"accent": "#ff8800", "bg-panel": "#202124"}`. [Commit Harbor: Appearance…](command:commitharbor.appearance.open) lists every token, and imports and exports them.

commitharbor.appearance.accent.patternErrorMessage: A color as #RGB, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, or empty for the accent of the theme.
commitharbor.appearance.accent.markdownDescription: Accent color of the Commit Harbor views: default button, focus ring, selected tab and progress. Empty: the accent of the theme. `#commitharbor.appearance.colorOverrides#` wins over it.

commitharbor.appearance.useCustomFont.markdownDescription: Use `#commitharbor.appearance.uiFontFamily#` and `#commitharbor.appearance.uiFontSize#` in the Commit Harbor views instead of Inter 13 (Accessibility › Use custom font).

commitharbor.appearance.uiFontFamily.markdownDescription: UI font of the Commit Harbor views while `#commitharbor.appearance.useCustomFont#` is on.

commitharbor.appearance.uiFontSize.markdownDescription: UI font size (px) of the Commit Harbor views while `#commitharbor.appearance.useCustomFont#` is on.

commitharbor.appearance.editorFontFamily.description: Monospaced font of diffs, commit messages and hashes in the Commit Harbor views (Editor › Font).

commitharbor.appearance.editorFontSize.description: Size (px) of the monospaced font in the Commit Harbor views (Editor › Font › Size).

commitharbor.appearance.compact.description: Compact mode: 20px rows and smaller headers, like the IDE's compact mode.

enumDescriptions: Paint the views with the IntelliJ New UI palette, typefaces and icons, like WebStorm.
Follow the colors and fonts of the active VS Code theme.
commitharbor.appearance.lookAndFeel.description: Look and feel of the Commit Harbor views.
commitharbor.appearance.lookAndFeel.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#commitharbor.appearance.theme#` instead: `vscode` there is this `vscode`. Still read while that setting is not set.

enumDescriptions: Open dialogs in a floating window, the closest thing to WebStorm's modal dialogs.
Open dialogs as editor tabs.
Use multi-step quick picks instead of dialogs.
commitharbor.dialogs.mode.description: How Commit Harbor dialogs (Pull, Merge, Rebase, Push…) are presented.

commitharbor.popups.preferQuickPick.description: Open the Branches and VCS Operations popups as native quick picks instead of the WebStorm-style popup.

commitharbor.gutter.showHover.description: Show the change popup (previous content and actions) when hovering changed lines, like WebStorm's gutter marker.

commitharbor.dev.autoReload.description: In the Extension Development Host, reload the webviews when their bundle changes and the window when the extension bundle changes.

enumDescriptions: The Commit Harbor diff viewer: two or three panes, Ignore / Highlighting modes of the IDE, chevrons that write into the working tree or the index, commit details header, Annotate and directory comparison.
The VS Code diff editor for two-side diffs (three-side diffs and directory comparisons still use the Commit Harbor viewer).
commitharbor.diff.viewer.description: Viewer for the diffs Commit Harbor opens from Compare with…, the Log, History, Annotate, stashes and the Push dialog (WebStorm: Settings › Tools › Diff & Merge). Show Diff of the Commit tool window keeps the VS Code editor, where the Include into Commit checkboxes live.

commitharbor.backgroundTasks.statusBar.description: Show running Git operations in the status bar (title, progress bar and cancel button) with a Background Tasks popup, like WebStorm, instead of progress notifications.

commitharbor.ai.model.markdownDescription: Language model of the AI actions (**Generate / Improve Commit Message with AI** in the Commit tool window, **Explain Commit** in the Log, **Merge with AI** in the Merge Revisions window): its family (such as `gpt-4o`, or `claude-code`, `codex`, `gemini-cli` for the AI command line tools), id or name, as **Commit Harbor: Select Language Model for AI Actions…** lists them. Empty: the first model offered — VS Code's Language Model API first (GitHub Copilot Chat or another provider), then the AI command line tools you have installed (see `#commitharbor.ai.cli.enabled#`). The diff of your changes is sent to it, with secret values (keys, tokens, passwords, `.env` files) replaced by `[REDACTED]`.

commitharbor.ai.cli.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer the AI command line tools you have installed and signed in to — **Claude Code** (`claude`), **OpenAI Codex CLI** (`codex`), **Gemini CLI** (`gemini`) — as language models of the AI actions, with your own subscription. Commit Harbor asks once per tool before the first request, sends the prompt on standard input, runs the tool in an empty temporary folder with its tools turned off, and stores no credentials. The diff, commit or conflicts go to the tool's provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) with secret values replaced by `[REDACTED]`.

commitharbor.ai.cli.claudePath.markdownDescription: Path to the Claude Code executable (`claude`). Empty: looked for on the `PATH` and in the usual install folders (`~/.local/bin`, `~/.claude/local`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, npm, Volta, Bun).

commitharbor.ai.cli.codexPath.markdownDescription: Path to the OpenAI Codex CLI executable (`codex`). Empty: looked for on the `PATH` and in the usual install folders (`/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, npm, Volta, Bun).

commitharbor.ai.cli.geminiPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Gemini CLI executable (`gemini`). Empty: looked for on the `PATH` and in the usual install folders (`/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, npm, Volta, Bun).

commitharbor.ai.cli.timeout.markdownDescription: Seconds an AI command line tool may take to answer one request of the AI actions before Commit Harbor stops it.

commitharbor.ai.commitMessage.convention.markdownDescription: Make **Generate Commit Message with AI** and **Improve Commit Message with AI** write [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) messages: a first line like `feat(parser): support arrays` (`type(scope): description`, with `!` and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer for breaking changes).

commitharbor.mcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Expose a read-only [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server with the repository's status, history, diffs, branches, blame, conflicts, stashes, shelves, worktrees and reflog to AI agents in VS Code (Copilot's agent mode lists it as **Commit Harbor**). It runs locally and never changes the repository; secret values are redacted. Nothing leaves the machine except what the agent itself sends to its model. Other agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI…) start their own copy: set them up in the **MCP** tab of the Git tool window ([Commit Harbor: AI Agents (MCP)…](command:commitharbor.mcp.show)).

commitharbor.gitflow.statusBar.description: Show the Git Flow item in the status bar (its popup starts and finishes features, releases and hotfixes) in repositories initialized for git-flow, like the Gitflow widget of the Git Flow Integration plugin.

colors.description: Files added in an inactive changelist
Files modified in an inactive changelist
Tracked files deleted from the file system
Files changed in the last N days
